mapper.sql: c.CUID, c.CID, c.CourseName, c.CourseImage, c.Teacher, c.LearnTime, c.Clicked, c.Orders, c.Recommend, c.Status, c.CreateTime, c.CourseExplain, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters ch WHERE ch.CUID = c.CUID AND ch.Status = 1) AS chapterCount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (CID, CourseName, CourseImage, Teacher, LearnTime, Clicked, Orders, Recommend, Status, CourseExplain) VALUES (#{cid}, #{courseName}, #{courseImage}, #{teacher}, #{learnTime}, #{clicked}, #{orders}, #{recommend}, #{status}, #{courseExplain})
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET Status = 0 WHERE CUID = #{cuid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM courses c WHERE c.Status = 0 ORDER BY c.CreateTime DESC, c.CUID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET Status = 1 WHERE CUID = #{cuid}
mapper.select: SELECT CUID FROM courses WHERE CID = #{cid}
